model.algorithm: Deterministic squared-error gradient boosting of depth-3 regression trees on log1p(mean reported FRP)

evaluation.task: Estimate mean reported FRP MW per source-positive H3 resolution-6 cell-day, conditional on actual detected hotspots with reported FRP. Not forecasting.

training.selection: Fixed parameters; no tuning on held-out results

evaluation.uncertainty: No calibrated prediction interval; empirical held-out errors are not individual uncertainty bounds.
limitations: EXPERIMENTAL conditional mean reported FRP per source-positive H3 cell-day, not future fire prediction.
No-record days are excluded, never labeled negatives. Labels reflect source-specific selection and reported FRP only.
VIIRS is not ground truth. Platform/product/processing strata remain separate; NOAA-20/21 Standard lineage is unresolved.
One-month Brazil pilot; no independent year holdout, no opportunity/cloud/geolocation QA or environmental covariates.
No calibrated uncertainty interval, downscaling, sensor-equivalent adjustment or historical reconstruction.

overlap.support: Source-positive H3 cell-days with reported FRP; source-only is absence of delivered counterpart, not a confirmed negative.
